title: Egyptian forward Salah signs two-year contract with Turkish club Trabzonspor
facts: Mohamed Salah signed a two-year contract with Turkish football club Trabzonspor.
Mohamed Salah will receive 17 million euros per season playing for Trabzonspor.
Mohamed Salah joined Trabzonspor on a free transfer.
Under his contract with Trabzonspor, Mohamed Salah will receive a 20 percent share from products sold under his name.
Mohamed Salah played for Liverpool for nine years before departing the club.
Mohamed Salah scored 257 goals in 442 appearances during his career at Liverpool.
Mohamed Salah won the Premier League title twice during his time at Liverpool.
Mohamed Salah won the UEFA Champions League title with Liverpool.
Mohamed Salah experienced a public disagreement with then-Liverpool manager Arne Slot.
Mohamed Salah began his European football career playing for Swiss club Basel in 2012.
Mohamed Salah played for English club Chelsea during his European career.
Mohamed Salah played for Italian clubs Fiorentina and AS Roma between 2015 and 2017.
Trabzonspor finished in third place in the Turkish Super Lig last season.
Trabzonspor's third-place league finish qualified the club for the Europa League playoff round.
Trabzonspor won its most recent domestic league championship in the 2021-22 season.
